name: Douglas Fir vs Oak in an Older Seattle Craftsman Home
title-tag: Douglas Fir vs Oak Floors in a Seattle Craftsman
meta-description: Most older Seattle Craftsmans have oak up front and Douglas fir in back — two different floors. Hardness, stain, sanding, and how to refinish a house with both.
post-summary: September 30, 2026 · Craftsman builders put oak in the front rooms and Douglas fir everywhere else — and they're not the same floor. The ten-second ID test, what Janka 660 vs 1290 means daily, why fir refuses stain, and how to refinish a house with both.
